Meanwhile, the latest polling shows Trump with some of the lowest approval ratings he's received.

A Sept. 16-20 American Research Group poll showed just 29% approval and disapproval ratings of 68%. In a Sept. 18-21 Economist/YouGov poll, Trump saw a 62% disapproval rating — and 58% disapproval of his ban on the three networks from the White House. In Michigan, a Sept. 22 Civiqs poll found a 58% disapproval rating of Trump's job performance.

Methodology

Each week, YouGov invites around 1,500 members of its opt-in panel to complete an online questionnaire. The respondents are selected to be representative of American adult citizens and the data is weighted to represent the country according to gender, age, race, education and voting behaviour. To track the results of YouGov’s polling over time, The Economist aggregates survey data each week and fits a line of best fit.
